design_thesis: The player must see, hear and feel the Master Pursuer long before the final boss.

pressure_link.pressure_25_49: silhouette visible in BG_B horizon, low horn motif
pressure_link.pressure_50_74: larger silhouette, shadow flicker, occasional lane warning
pressure_link.pressure_75_99: near silhouette, hoof tremor, music pressure layer
pressure_link.pressure_100: caught state or forced boss approach according to scene rules

sector_presence_scale.role: meteor impacts feel guided by the pursuer
glass lanes crack under its rhythm

visual_signals.gameplay_function: warns high danger without hiding lane

budget_policy.first_slice: single small BG_B silhouette plus optional palette flash; no giant sprite
budget_policy.fallback: use palette and audio motif if silhouette budget is not available
forbidden: large pursuer sprite before scanline budget report

validation_plan: Sector 01 screenshot shows pursuer hint without covering playfield
Audio cues do not mask damage or telegraph SFX
BlastEm capture required before any visual delivery claim
